label: Homebrew cache
note: Old downloads and outdated versions. Runs brew cleanup.

label: npm cache
note: Downloaded packages. Rebuilt as you install.

label: pnpm store
note: Removes only packages no project uses. Runs pnpm store prune.

label: Yarn cache
note: Downloaded packages. Rebuilt as you install.

label: Go build cache
note: The first build afterwards is slower.

label: Gradle cache
note: The next Android or Java build downloads dependencies again.

label: Xcode DerivedData
note: Build products and indexes. Rebuilt by Xcode.

label: Spotify cache
note: Cached songs and artwork. Quit Spotify first.

label: Notion cache
note: Page content already synced to the cloud. Quit Notion first.

label: VS Code caches
note: Extension packages and compiled caches. Quit VS Code first.

label: Arc browser cache
note: Web cache only. Bookmarks and history are not touched. Quit Arc first.

label: Discord downloads
note: Update packages already installed. Quit Discord first.

label: Claude Desktop VM
note: Sandbox image for code execution. Downloads again if you use the feature. Quit Claude first.

label: Claude Desktop updater cache
note: Update packages that are already installed.

label: System logs
note: Root-owned. Find the biggest file, then truncate it yourself in Terminal. Tobias never runs sudo.

label: uv cache
note: Downloaded Python packages. Rebuilt as you install.

label: Bun cache
note: Downloaded packages. Rebuilt as you install.

label: Hugging Face models
note: Downloaded models and datasets. They download again when a tool asks for them.

label: Codex runtimes
note: Runtimes downloaded by Codex. They download again when needed.

label: Cypress binaries
note: Downloaded test runner. Run npx cypress install to get it back.

label: Playwright browsers
note: Downloaded browsers. Run npx playwright install to get them back.

label: Docker update staging
note: A downloaded Docker Desktop update that was never applied. Quit Docker first.

label: Android emulator images
note: Virtual devices that use these images stop working until you install them again in Android Studio's SDK Manager. Quit Android Studio first.
